question: Will Bitcoin ETF net inflows exceed $50 billion in 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the total calendar-year 2026 net inflows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs exceed $50 billion USD as of the market's settlement time.
- "No": Wins if the total calendar-year 2026 net inflows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs are $50 billion USD or less as of the market's settlement time.

Clarifications:
- "Total calendar-year 2026 net inflows" means the sum of all daily net inflows (creations minus redemptions, in USD) across all US-listed spot Bitcoin ETFs from January 1, 2026 through the market's settlement date, inclusive, as reported by established ETF flow trackers such as SoSoValue or Farside Investors. Days with net outflows reduce the cumulative total; non-trading days (weekends and US market holidays) count as zero.
